text:
eva: Quick sync — we need a pragmatic plan to support legacy routes while we finalize the new interface. goal: minimize customer friction during Q3 launches and set a clear sunset window.
marco: +1. Primary risks are tool/function-calling contract changes and structured output shape differences. customers with complex tool chains will break silently.
priya: Agree. Suggestion: two-tier compatibility strategy — 1) 'compat headers' that opt-in runtime shims, 2) a migration guide + SDK helpers to rewrite calls.
leah: Love the header idea. Something like `X-RW-Compat: v1` to force runtime to apply v1 response envelope and legacy parameter mapping.
marco: Example header shim we tested:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
     -H "X-RW-Compat: v1" \
     -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":64}' \
     https://api.redwood.ai/v2/completions
```
If header present, runtime returns `choices[].text` and old `usage` fields.
eva: small nit: we should avoid special-case code in the runtime for more than 12 months. plan needs a hard sunset.
priya: proposal: v1 routes remain fully supported for 12 months after v2 GA; opt-in compat headers for another 6 months (read-only) — total 18 months max. after that, 301 responses with migration URL and SDK auto-upgrade prompts.
marco: acceptance gates for deprecation:
- migration guide published and reviewed by solutions engineering
- SDK patch with auto-migration helpers released in major languages
- e2e customer tests for top 10 customers passing
- benchmarks show <5% median latency regression when compat shims enabled
leah: also need a test harness for tool-calling regressions. shim can translate old function signature to new `tools` schema but we must assert semantics. add a golden prompt set.
priya: timeline draft:
- 2026-05-10: public beta of v2 routes + compat header feature
- 2026-06-01: migration guide + SDK helpers v0.1
- 2026-09-01: v1 routes enter deprecation mode (new customers blocked; existing customers get warnings)
- 2027-03-01: v1 sunset (responses return 301 + guidance)
marco: those dates look reasonable. flag: enterprise customers on private deployments may need longer; propose opt-out window with contract amendment.
eva: yes, offer an extended-support SKU (paid) for private installs. ops needs to know so SLA teams can price it.
leah: who owns the migration guide and the golden prompt set?
priya: product + devex will own the guide. eng-ml + eng-runtime own shim implementation and tests. solutions eng owns the top-10 customer validations.
sam-deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: runtime/compat-shim v0.9 -> canary cluster at 2026-04-28T16:00Z (automated notice).
marco: follow-ups:
1) priya/lea — draft migration guide outline by EOD Friday
2) marco/eng-runtime — prototype header shim with optional mode flag by next week
3) devex — SDK PR templates for auto-upgrade helpers
4) ops + sales — draft extended-support pricing for private customers
priya: outline items I'll include:
- mapping table: v1 params -> v2 params
- function/tool calling migration patterns (examples + tests)
- structured-output diffs and validator snippets
- embedding dimensionality/namespace changes and upgrade script
leah: validator snippet idea: run linter on responses to ensure required fields exist, fail CI if missing. share proto example.
marco: decision log: compatibility header = temporary opt-in shim; runtime to log occurrences and emit telemetry. sunset capped at 18 months. SDKs to provide opt-in auto-rewrite helpers. enterprise extended support available.
eva: ok — I'm happy with that. priya/leah, please post the draft guide in #product by Friday and ping legal for deprecation language review.
priya: will do. tagging @leah for the golden prompt list.
leah: on it. I'll add a short test plan to the doc.
marco: thanks all — we'll sync again after the guide draft. :thumbsup:
